item.title: Martin University alumni fight to keep doors open
item.description: Martin University alumni have called for leadership changes and increased accountability to save Indiana's only Predominantly Black Institution of higher learning. The Board of Trustees announced Dec. 17, 2025, that it's is suspending operations due to financial difficulties and decreased student enrollment.

item.title: Martin University, Indiana’s sole Predominantly Black Institution, to suspend operations

item.title: Voucher cuts force child care closures
item.description: A northeast side child care provider in Indianapolis closed due to the state's child care voucher cuts, which have resulted in a net loss of 1,187 seats in early child care classrooms and have affected both families who use vouchers and those who don't.

item.title: Indianapolis man charged with murder of father, attempted murder of mother
item.description: Bryan L. Pedigo , 54, was formally charged with murder and attempted murder for allegedly killing his 81-year-old father, John Pedigo, and seriously injuring his mother, Olanna Pedigo, at their home in Indianapolis.
